# PDF.js runtime

This directory contains the browser runtime required by the static reader.

- Project: Mozilla PDF.js / `pdfjs-dist`
- Version: `6.2.108`
- Package source: `https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.2.108.tgz`
- License: Apache License 2.0; see `LICENSE`
- Included runtime files: `pdf.min.mjs`, `pdf.worker.min.mjs`,
  `pdf_viewer.mjs`, `pdf_viewer.css`, and the viewer image resources

The reader has no CDN or analytics dependency. The book itself remains under
its separately stated GNU Free Documentation License.
